[list]

notes.title: Demo Feedback Update!
notes.content:
Thank for playing the game and giving me feedback!

[list]
[*] Fixed duplicate/missing Ending Tokens
[*] Fixed buttons to only use left click as valid press input
[*] Map & Action Points got a few tweaks and enhancements, and clarifications
[*] added a prompt for log during option presentation
[*] ALT + ENTER can now be used to toggle window/full-screen
[*] other minor adjustments
[/list]
